findings.summary: Early PRs for jobs that fail verification stay open, and the plan does not mention it.
findings.evidence: The early step opens a PR for every admitted candidate. If verification then fails, or the job is abandoned, nothing in the plan closes the PR or deletes athena/<job>. So the plan leaves open PRs that will never land, each named 'Verification in progress'. Fix: Add this as a risk. Say in CHANGELOG.md that failed jobs leave their early PR open. Or name it as follow-up work; closing PRs needs a new PrHost method, which is out of scope.

findings.summary: The synchronous early step delays the start of verification.
findings.evidence: early_pr runs synchronously on the go thread before verifier_snapshot. A slow git push, or GhClient retries, delays the start of verification by that much, and that works against the stated goal of a faster pipeline. Fix: State the bound in Risks: the GhClient retry limit and the git push time. Note that running the step in the background was rejected to keep go simple and deterministic.

findings.summary: The land half of criterion 2 does not say how land avoids the real remote.
findings.evidence: Athena::land_pr (gh.rs:2096–2155) builds a real GitRemote and GitLandingRecords::for_remote. The cfg(test) seam described covers only the early step. Land at the Athena level with an https origin would try a real push. Fix: Say that the land half of criterion 2 uses the free land_pr through the test_support.rs helper (line 411–423), with the same FakeRemote state and the pr-early.json that go wrote. Or say the seam also covers Athena::land_pr.
findings.location: Demonstration for criterion 2, 'Then run land on (b) and (c)'

findings.summary: The 'no verification record present' check names no file.
findings.evidence: The plan does not name the file or record whose absence it checks, and verification results may be written only at closing. Fix: Name the exact path or record that is checked, or rely only on the verifier invocation count.

summary: I read gh.rs, pr.rs and run.rs and checked the plan against them. The plan fits the code. `check_replace` and `ReplaceRequest` already exist in pr.rs (lines 152–192) and nothing calls them yet, so using them is natural. `Remote` (gh.rs:571) has no replace method, and its docs say there is "deliberately no way to replace a remote head". The plan adds a default-bodied method and updates those docs. That keeps `NoRemote` in crates/athena-cli/tests/external_calls.rs:437 compiling. `publish` (gh.rs:1953) calls `check_push`, which would refuse to put L over C, so the plan's state-file-then-replace design fixes a real failure mode. `parse_remote` (gh.rs:1199) uses `url.find(HOST)`, so the https guard is justified. `produce_and_verify` runs on the caller's thread: run.rs:418 calls it directly and run.rs has no spawn, so the thread-local seam will reach it. The insertion point after admission (run.rs:1640) and before `verifier_snapshot` (run.rs:1647) means only admitted candidates are pushed. Each demonstration covers its criterion and would fail without the behavior. The remaining issues are minor: early PRs are left open when verification fails, the early step blocks verifier start, and the criterion-2 land step needs a stated route.
